jp: ＜僕らの撲殺寸前事件・温泉編＞
en:
Bonus Scenario 10
The Day We Were Nearly Beaten to Death: Hot Spring Edition
Cain. How much further to the hot spring?

jp: この辺りだと思うんだけど・・・
en: Hmm... I thought it was around here...
Don't tell me you're lost, Cain?

jp: フライから聞いた通りに
歩いているはずなんだけど・・・
en: That's weird... I'm sure I'm going the way Fly told me...

jp: ちょっと疲れちゃった・・・
en: Syria-neesan... Lilis is a little tired...
Are you all right, Lilis?

jp: 戻ったほうが良くないか
en: Shouldn't we head back, Cain?
Yeah, but...
Pushing it too hard isn't good either, Cain.
Everyone, I'm sorry...
Please, don't apologize, Cain-san...

jp: この辺りはアタシ達でも
en: It can't be helped, Cain. Even we get lost easily around here.
Yeah...
We're heading back...

jp: リリス、ほら背中にのれよ
en: Right. Lilis, come on, hop on my back.
Thank you, Exal.
I'm really sorry, everyone...

jp: そんなに謝らなくていいよ
en: Cain, you don't need to apologize so much.
Luca...

jp: ・・・気持ちだけで十分だよ
en: ...The thought is more than enough.
Huh...

jp: 置いて行くぞ二人とも！
en: Heeey! We're leaving you two behind!
Let's go, Cain.
Yeah!

jp: ＜僕らの撲殺寸前事件・温泉編＞
en:
Bonus Scenario 10
The Day We Were Nearly Beaten to Death: Hot Spring Edition
Heeey, aren't we there yet?
Just a sec, okaaay?
Hey, Cain. Are we really okay with that one leading the way?
I think so...

jp: スプーン持つのどっちだっけ？
en: Umm... which hand holds the spoon again?
Lilis holds it with this one!
Ahh, then it's this waaay!
Wha!? Hey! Wait a second! Isn't that backwards?
Nooo, this way's riiight.

jp: スプーンを持つのはこっちだ！
en: You hold a spoon with THIS hand!
Ahh, right! Sorryyy.

jp: わからなくなるんだよね～
en: I get mixed up sometimes... I'm ambidextrous, see.

jp: へぇ～、フライって器用だね
en: Wow, Fly, you're pretty handy.

jp: うん、サーカスに入って
en: Yep, I joined the circus and trained real hard!

jp: ほう、それは大変だな・・・
en: Oh? That must have been hard work...

jp: 本当に大変だったんだ～
en: Oh, you get it? It really was hard, mister in the mask!

jp: ねぇ、どうでもいいでしょ
それより温泉はまだなの？
en: Who cares about any of that... More importantly, how far is this hot spring?

jp: 確か、この先だったはず～
en: Hmm... I'm pretty sure it was just ahead...
Ah! Wow! Look at all the steam puffing up!
Lilis-chan! Don't run, it's dangerous!
We made it, Cain!
Thanks, Fly.

jp: 僕とカインの仲だもの～
また、サーカスを手伝ってね♪
en: No problem! You and me are pals, Cain. Help out at the circus again, okay?
Ha ha ha, sure.

jp: あんまり奥に行かないでね～
en: Oh, right. Don't go too far in, okay?
Is there something back there?

jp: 大丈夫だと思うけど・・・
en: Sort of... I think it's fine, but...
What do you mean?

jp: それじゃ、僕は戻るけど
en: Oh, never mind... Anyway, I'm heading back. You'll be okay getting home, right?
Yes, we'll be fine around here, Fly.
See you later, then!
Hey.
Hm? What is it, mister?

jp: スプーンを持つのはどっちだ？
en: Which hand holds the spoon?
Umm... ......this one?
Other one.

jp: これが温泉ってやつか？
en: Huh... So this is a hot spring?
Yeah, looks like it.

jp: 地面からお湯が出てくるなんて
en: Amazing. Hot water coming out of the ground... The underworld sure is handy.

jp: 地熱で暖められた水が
湧き出しているのだろう
en: Water heated by the earth's heat is welling up, most likely.

jp: 変わったニオイがするね
en: It smells kind of odd, doesn't it?

jp: これは硫黄のニオイだ
en: That is the smell of sulfur.

jp: だが無色で無臭に近い
多分、成分は薄いだろうな・・
en: But it is colorless and nearly odorless. The minerals are probably thin...

jp: 効果が低いってことなの？
en: Does that mean it doesn't work as well?

jp: 健康どころか泉質が合わないため
肌が荒れる恐れもある
en: No. If too strong, it may not suit the skin and roughen it rather than help.

jp: 高齢者にも利用しやすい湯
といったところだろう
en: Well, call it the safest sort of bath, easy even for the elderly to use.

jp: ヨハネって温泉にもくわしいんだ
en: Huh... You know about hot springs too, Johannes?

jp: ああ、メフィストのために
ありとあらゆる療法を
en: Yes. I looked into every remedy there is, for Mephisto's sake.
I see...

jp: アタシに、この温泉とかいうのに
en: So... you're telling me to get into this "hot spring" thing?
Yeah, that's right!

jp: アタシに、脱げっていうの？
en: You're telling me to strip?

jp: カインったら意外と大胆なのね
en: Such a cute face, and yet you're surprisingly bold, Cain.
Eh!?

jp: そんな意味じゃないよ！！！
en: N-no!! That's not what I meant!!!
Just kidding.
I don't mind getting in, but we need to decide: men first, or women first?
Ah... yeah, right.

jp: どうしてもっていうなら・・
カインはアタシと一緒に入る？
en: If you insist... want to get in with me, Cain?
Wawawawah!?
N-no, we can't do that!

jp: ちゃんと意識しちゃうあたりは
カインも男の子なのね
en: Oh... So you ARE aware of it. Guess Cain's a boy after all.

jp: あんた達が先なのか・・・
en: So, what'll it be? Do we go first, or do you?
What will you do?
After you
We'll go first...

jp: ボク達は後でいいから
ルカ達が先に入っていいよ
en: We can go after, so you girls go in first, Luca.

jp: じゃあ、そうさせてもらうわ
en: Then we'll take you up on that.

jp: じゃあ、男たちは回れ右して
en: All right, men: about-face, and at least five hundred paces that way!

jp: 少しでもこっちを振り向く
そぶりを見せたら、殺すわよ
en: Fair warning: so much as a hint of turning this way, and I'll kill you.
As if anyone would go out of their way to look at that.
WHAT did you say!? What do you mean, "that"!?

jp: お湯もあつくないみたいですね
en: The water isn't as hot as I expected.

jp: リリス一番のりするの！
en: Yaaay! Lilis is going in first!

jp: まだ後ろにみなさんがいるのに
en: Lilis, honestly! Everyone is still right behind us!
Huh? Lilis doesn't mind.

jp: わかったらすぐに行く！
en: Just go, five hundred paces back! Now that you get it, move! Understood?
Yeah, yeah, we get it.
If you get it, about-face!
Yes, yes.

jp: あー・・・そういえば
en: Oh... come to think of it...
Once we've walked five hundred paces, can we turn around...

jp: 絶対に振り返るなって言った
ばかりでしょーーーがッ！！
en: I JUST told you not to turn around no matter WHAT, didn't I!!
Gwaaaaaaah!!
...Guh.
Turn around, and that's what you get. Got it?

jp: 絶対に振り返らないよ
en: ...Y-yeah, I won't turn around. I'll never turn around.

jp: ボク達が先に入ってもいい？
en: Can we go in first?
...Sure.

jp: 実験台になってもらうのも
en: Letting you go first and be our guinea pigs isn't a bad idea.
G-guinea pigs...?

jp: 入りたいなら勝手にしろ
en: I'm not interested. If you want in, suit yourselves.

jp: 相変わらず協調性がないわね～
en: Not a team player, as usual.

jp: あんただって休み知らずで
戦い疲れてるんだから
ドーンっと入ってきなさいよ！
en: You've been fighting without a break too, so get in there and soak!
There!

jp: あー、ごめん・・・って言っても
どうしようもないわよね
en: Oh, sorry... not that saying it helps now that you've already fallen in.

jp: いったいどういうつもりで・・
en: Hey, you. What the hell do you think you're...

jp: ちょうどいいじゃない？
もう入っちゃったんだし
しっかり癒されてきなさいよ
en: Perfect timing, right? You're already in, so go on and get properly healed.
Ha ha ha ha! Lookin' good, Zion.

jp: 水もしたたるいい男ならぬ
お湯もしたたるいい男！
en: Look at you! Forget "dripping wet and handsome" -- you're dripping HOT and handsome!
...You fall in too.
Huh?
Uwaaaaaah!!
Exal!?

jp: よくもやりやがったな！！！
en: Dammit... How dare you!!

jp: ザイオンとエクサルが・・・
en: Hey, Johannes. Zion and Exal are...

jp: 若者同士のじゃれあいだ
青春に水をさしては悪いだろう？
en: Young men horsing around. It would be a shame to throw cold water on their youth.

jp: なんだか楽しそうだね
en: Youth, huh... That looks kind of fun.

jp: ボクも青春してきていい？
en: Hey, hey, Johannes. Can I go have some youth too?
You will get dizzy. Just bathe normally.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
